svg.aria-label: VoiceWave: private dictation for Windows. Hold Ctrl + Win, speak, and your words appear in any app.
svg.title: VoiceWave: private dictation for Windows. Hold Ctrl + Win, speak, and your words appear in any app.

g.text: Hold Ctrl + Win, speak, let go. Your words appear in any app,
transcribed on your own PC and never sent to the cloud.
